english_explanations: to take a number or amount away from another

chinese_translations.english: to take a number or amount away from another number or total

english_explanations: a small thin publication with a paper cover giving information

chinese_translations.english: a small thin publication giving information on a single subject
chinese_translations.example: Health clinics distribute a simple pamphlet explaining vaccination schedules to parents in remote villages.

english_explanations: the scientific study of how characteristics pass from parents to offspring

chinese_translations.english: the branch of biology studying how characteristics are inherited from parents to offspring

english_explanations: relating to a legislative chamber or chambers

chinese_translations.english: relating to a chamber of a legislative assembly

english_explanations: to achieve what you attempted
to follow next in a position or order

chinese_translations.english: to achieve an aim, or to come next after someone or something in order or position

english_explanations: an event in which people compete for a prize
the act of trying to win something that others also want

chinese_translations.english: an organised event in which people compete, or the struggle to win business or advantage

english_explanations: at or near the back of something

chinese_translations.english: at or near the back part of something

english_explanations: to fasten something in place with a narrow band
to tie a band firmly around something

chinese_translations.english: to fasten or hold something in place with a narrow band of material
chinese_translations.example: Hospital staff strap the injured limb securely before transferring the patient to the emergency theatre.

english_explanations: an instrument that makes very small objects look larger

chinese_translations.english: an instrument using lenses to make tiny objects appear much larger

english_explanations: a large formal meeting for discussion
a meeting to exchange opinions on a subject

chinese_translations.english: a large formal meeting where people exchange views on a subject
chinese_translations.example: The annual climate conference brings together scientists and policymakers to review global emission targets.

english_explanations: relating to bacteria or caused by bacteria

chinese_translations.english: relating to bacteria or caused by them

english_explanations: a payment made to an agent, usually as a percentage of sales
an official task given to a person or body

chinese_translations.english: a payment to an agent based on sales, or an official task or order given to someone

english_explanations: to put data into a computer or system

chinese_translations.english: to put information into a computer or other system
chinese_translations.example: Assistants input thousands of survey responses into the database each week during the national census.

english_explanations: unable to pay debts and legally declared unable to pay them
completely lacking something valuable

chinese_translations.english: legally unable to pay debts, or completely lacking a quality or resource
chinese_translations.example: The airline went bankrupt after fuel costs rose sharply and passenger numbers collapsed during the recession.

english_explanations: a broad curve of coastline where the sea cuts into the land

chinese_translations.english: a broad curved inlet of sea partly surrounded by land
chinese_translations.example: Fishing communities around the sheltered bay have developed sustainable aquaculture projects in recent decades.

english_explanations: the state of continuing without stopping or changing

chinese_translations.english: the state of continuing smoothly over time without interruption or change
chinese_translations.example: Continuity of care from the same family doctor measurably improves patient outcomes in chronic illness management.

english_explanations: to cause great physical or mental suffering
to keep annoying someone repeatedly

chinese_translations.english: to cause severe physical or mental suffering, or to annoy someone persistently
chinese_translations.example: Refugees were tormented by memories of the conflict while rebuilding their lives in unfamiliar cities.

english_explanations: used to introduce the subject of a statement

chinese_translations.english: used to introduce the subject that is being discussed or asked about
chinese_translations.example: The committee issued detailed guidance regarding the safe disposal of electronic waste in urban areas.

english_explanations: a warning of possible danger
the state of being ready to notice danger

chinese_translations.english: a signal or warning of danger, or the state of watchful readiness
chinese_translations.example: Health authorities issued a national alert after several confirmed cases of the new respiratory infection.

english_explanations: to provide an organisation with the workers it needs

chinese_translations.english: to provide people to work in an organisation or service

english_explanations: the sudden bursting of a volcano
a sudden appearance of spots or a disease

chinese_translations.english: the sudden bursting out of lava from a volcano, or a sudden outbreak of disease or spots

english_explanations: to make an action seem reasonable or necessary
to officially guarantee something

chinese_translations.english: to make an action reasonable or necessary, or to officially guarantee something

english_explanations: the same in size, amount, value or status

chinese_translations.english: the same in size, amount, number or value, or having the same rights and status

english_explanations: a large area of land or space with particular features

chinese_translations.english: a large area of land distinguished by particular features, or a layer of the atmosphere

english_explanations: carefully chosen from a larger group
limited to a special group of people

chinese_translations.meaning: 精选的；挑选出来的；精英的
chinese_translations.english: chosen carefully from a larger group as being of the best quality

english_explanations: able to be seen
clearly noticeable

chinese_translations.meaning: 可见的；看得见的；明显的
chinese_translations.english: able to be seen, or clearly noticeable to the eye or mind

english_explanations: a large room where students or workers eat meals

chinese_translations.english: a large room in a college or institution where meals are served

english_explanations: an imaginary creature that is large, ugly and frightening
something enormous in size

chinese_translations.english: an imaginary frightening creature, or something extraordinarily large

english_explanations: a community of living things interacting with their environment

chinese_translations.english: all the plants, animals and surroundings in an area functioning together as one system

english_explanations: to lend something, especially money
money borrowed from a bank and repaid with interest

chinese_translations.english: to lend money or something valuable, usually for interest
chinese_translations.example: Regional development banks loan funds to renewable energy startups that traditional lenders often overlook entirely.

english_explanations: an area marked out for a particular purpose or use

chinese_translations.english: an area of land or sea marked by a particular feature, use or rule
chinese_translations.example: The city designated a low emission zone to reduce air pollution from older diesel vehicles downtown.

english_explanations: to officially join a school, course or organisation
to put someone's name on an official list

chinese_translations.english: to officially record someone as a member of a school, course or organisation
chinese_translations.example: Adult education centres enroll thousands of part-time students each autumn across the country's major cities.

english_explanations: extremely large in size or amount

chinese_translations.english: extremely large in size, amount or degree

english_explanations: to make a bad situation worse

chinese_translations.english: to make a problem or bad situation even worse

english_explanations: to tie things together firmly
to force someone to obey a rule or agreement

chinese_translations.english: to tie things firmly together, or to place someone under a duty by an agreement

english_explanations: the time during which something continues

chinese_translations.english: the length of time that something continues

english_explanations: relating to the quality or nature of something rather than its amount

chinese_translations.english: relating to the character or quality of something rather than a numerical measure

english_explanations: to give food to a person, animal or machine

chinese_translations.english: to give food to a person, animal or process, or to supply something into a machine

english_explanations: completely different from something or opposing it

chinese_translations.english: completely different from or opposed to something already said or believed

english_explanations: to put something where people can see it
to show a feeling, skill or information clearly

chinese_translations.english: to arrange something so people can see it, or to show a quality or information clearly

english_explanations: happy and satisfied with what you have

chinese_translations.english: happy and satisfied with the present situation

english_explanations: to judge the value or quality of something carefully

chinese_translations.english: to judge the value, quality or importance of something after careful thought

english_explanations: to speak with difficulty, repeating sounds because of nerves or a speech problem

chinese_translations.english: to speak with sudden pauses and repeated sounds because of a speech difficulty or nerves

english_explanations: a small long thin animal with a soft tube-shaped body and no legs

chinese_translations.english: a small long soft-bodied animal without legs, or a screw-shaped mechanical part

english_explanations: the process of becoming larger in size, amount or scope

chinese_translations.english: the process of increasing in size, amount or scope

english_explanations: happening in a series, one after another

chinese_translations.meaning: 连续的；顺序排列的；连载的
chinese_translations.english: arranged or happening in a regular sequence, or published or broadcast in parts
chinese_translations.example: Serial numbering on shipped vaccine vials allows regulators to trace every dose through the cold chain.

english_explanations: medical treatment in which a doctor cuts into the body to repair or remove something

chinese_translations.english: medical treatment involving cutting into the body to repair or remove something

english_explanations: to be or put all around something

chinese_translations.english: to gather or be positioned all around something or someone
chinese_translations.example: Dense mangrove forests surround the lagoon, sheltering juvenile fish from strong ocean currents nearby.

english_explanations: a border that holds something such as a picture or door

chinese_translations.english: a rigid structure that surrounds or supports something, such as a picture or building
chinese_translations.example: Aluminium frames have replaced heavier steel in modern window design to improve building energy ratings.

english_explanations: an infectious disease like a severe cold, causing fever and aches

chinese_translations.english: an infectious viral illness causing fever, aches and breathing difficulty

english_explanations: the process of making a bad situation worse

chinese_translations.english: the act of making a bad condition worse, or a feeling of annoyance

english_explanations: to close your fingers or teeth tightly together

chinese_translations.english: to close hands or teeth tightly together, often from anger or effort
chinese_translations.example: Athletes clench their fists involuntarily during tense final seconds of championship races, sports psychologists observe.

english_explanations: a person whose job is to organise people and activities so they work together

chinese_translations.english: a person who arranges people and activities so that they work together effectively
chinese_translations.example: The project coordinator scheduled weekly meetings between engineers and community representatives to resolve disputes quickly.

english_explanations: to add something extra to make an amount or thing more complete

chinese_translations.english: to add something extra to improve or complete something else
chinese_translations.example: Many rural households supplement their farm income by selling handicrafts through online marketplaces.

english_explanations: a document listing goods supplied and the amount to be paid

chinese_translations.english: a formal document listing goods or services provided and the money owed
chinese_translations.example: Small exporters now issue electronic invoices automatically, cutting paperwork delays at customs clearance points.

english_explanations: an amount or number of something that can be measured

chinese_translations.english: an amount of something that can be counted or measured
chinese_translations.example: Factories measure the exact quantity of raw materials consumed to reduce industrial waste each quarter.

english_explanations: moving in the same direction as the hands of a clock

chinese_translations.english: moving in the same direction as the hands of a clock turn
chinese_translations.example: Ceiling fans set clockwise in winter push warm air down gently and reduce heating bills noticeably.

english_explanations: an act of holding someone closely in the arms

chinese_translations.english: an act of putting the arms around someone, or the willing acceptance of an idea

english_explanations: to take part in something without permission and cause problems

chinese_translations.english: to deliberately get involved in something that is not your concern, or to obstruct a process

english_explanations: a sum of money given by an organisation for a particular purpose

chinese_translations.meaning: 拨款；补助金；助学金；授权
chinese_translations.english: a sum of money given by a government or organisation for a specific purpose

english_explanations: lack of knowledge or information about something

chinese_translations.english: a lack of knowledge or information about a subject

english_explanations: an important discovery or development that solves a problem

chinese_translations.meaning: 突破；重大进展；重大发现
chinese_translations.english: an important discovery or sudden advance that removes an obstacle

english_explanations: to state an idea clearly and in detail
to create a plan or method carefully

chinese_translations.meaning: 系统地阐述；制定；明确表达
chinese_translations.english: to express an idea clearly and systematically, or to prepare a plan carefully
chinese_translations.example: Economists formulated a new model of household spending that better predicts responses to interest rate changes.

english_explanations: the lever of a gun that fires the bullet

english_explanations: goods carried by ship, train or plane

chinese_translations.english: goods transported in bulk by ship, train or aircraft, or the charge for carrying them

english_explanations: a person skilled in planning actions to achieve long-term aims

chinese_translations.english: a person skilled in planning long-term actions to reach a goal
chinese_translations.example: The company hired a seasoned strategist to guide its expansion into rapidly growing overseas markets.

english_explanations: to grow or develop quickly

chinese_translations.english: to grow or develop rapidly, or to begin to grow leaves or shoots

english_explanations: showing care and attention for other people's needs
thinking seriously about something

chinese_translations.meaning: 深思熟虑的；体贴的；沉思的
chinese_translations.english: showing careful consideration or attention to the needs and feelings of others
chinese_translations.example: Thoughtful urban design places benches and shade trees along walking routes used by elderly residents daily.

english_explanations: an agreement reached by both sides accepting less than they first wanted

chinese_translations.english: an agreement in which both sides accept less than they originally demanded
chinese_translations.example: The two parties reached a compromise that balanced industrial growth with stricter river protection standards.

english_explanations: too small or unimportant to matter

chinese_translations.meaning: 无关紧要的；微不足道的
chinese_translations.english: too small or unimportant to have any real effect or value
chinese_translations.example: Measured against national emissions, household lighting appears insignificant, yet efficiency gains remain worthwhile.

english_explanations: to refuse to accept something and fight against it
to remain undamaged by something harmful

chinese_translations.english: to fight against something, or to remain unaffected by a disease, heat or pressure
chinese_translations.example: New rice varieties resist drought far better, protecting harvests across increasingly unpredictable monsoon regions.

english_explanations: a promise to do something or to behave in a particular way

chinese_translations.english: a firm promise to do something, or loyal devotion of time and energy to a cause

english_explanations: to take in and understand information fully

english_explanations: to become smaller, weaker or less in amount

english_explanations: an open area or system where people buy and sell goods

chinese_translations.english: a place or system where goods are bought and sold and businesses compete
chinese_translations.example: Online marketplaces have transformed how independent artisans reach customers far beyond their home regions.

english_explanations: a solid slightly greasy substance that melts with heat, used in candles and polish

chinese_translations.english: a soft solid substance that melts easily, used in candles, polishes and cosmetics
chinese_translations.example: Furniture makers still prefer natural wax finishes that protect antique wood without trapping moisture underneath.

english_explanations: a network of crossing lines used to mark positions on a map

chinese_translations.english: a pattern of crossing lines marking positions, or the network supplying electricity across a region
chinese_translations.example: Engineers upgraded the national power grid so remote villages could receive reliable electricity during storms.

english_explanations: to become stronger or make something stronger

chinese_translations.english: to become greater in strength or degree, or to make something do so
chinese_translations.example: Rising sea temperatures intensify coastal storms, threatening fishing communities across several tropical archipelagos.

english_explanations: advice given to help someone decide

chinese_translations.english: professional advice, especially from a lawyer, or the lawyer giving it
chinese_translations.example: Students facing disciplinary hearings may seek counsel from independent advisers appointed by the university union.

english_explanations: a metal piece that joins a door to its frame and lets it swing

chinese_translations.english: a piece of metal joining a door or lid to its frame so it can swing, or a central point something depends on
chinese_translations.example: Corrosion-resistant hinges extend the lifespan of external doors in humid coastal housing developments considerably.

english_explanations: not good enough or not achieving what was hoped

chinese_translations.meaning: 不能令人满意的；不合格的
chinese_translations.english: not good enough or failing to reach an acceptable standard
chinese_translations.example: Inspectors judged the bridge's maintenance unsatisfactory and ordered repairs before the winter traffic season.

english_explanations: a small flap or label attached to something for identification

chinese_translations.english: a small projecting label used to mark or identify something, or an account of money owed
chinese_translations.example: Coloured tabs help archivists locate individual manuscripts quickly within enormous digitised library collections.

english_explanations: to plan that something will happen at a particular time

chinese_translations.english: to plan for an event or activity to happen at a particular time
chinese_translations.example: Engineers schedule routine bridge inspections every spring to catch frost damage before holiday travel peaks.

english_explanations: to look at something quickly to find the main points

chinese_translations.english: to look quickly over something for information, or to examine a body or document with a scanner
chinese_translations.example: Security staff scan every bag at the terminal entrance, keeping queues short during peak holiday seasons.

english_explanations: the ability to see

chinese_translations.english: the ability to see things
chinese_translations.example: Regular screening in primary schools detects poor eyesight early, preventing avoidable learning difficulties later.

english_explanations: a typical quality or feature of a person or thing

chinese_translations.english: a quality or feature that is typical of a person, thing or group
chinese_translations.example: Ductility is the defining characteristic of copper, making it ideal for wiring in modern buildings.

english_explanations: to spend most of your time working or studying one particular subject

chinese_translations.english: to limit most of one's work or study to one particular subject or activity
chinese_translations.example: Wildlife veterinarians specialise in treating injuries unique to migratory birds passing through protected wetlands.

english_explanations: to give special attention to something important

chinese_translations.english: to give special importance or attention to something, or to make it clearly noticeable
chinese_translations.example: The annual report highlights the widening gap in broadband access between rural and urban households.

english_explanations: a hard building material made from cement, sand and gravel

chinese_translations.english: a hard grey building material made by mixing cement, sand, gravel and water
chinese_translations.example: Engineers now mix recycled glass into concrete to reduce the building industry's considerable carbon footprint.

english_explanations: the practice of obeying rules and controlling behaviour
an area of study or knowledge

chinese_translations.english: controlled behaviour produced by training and rules, or a branch of academic study
chinese_translations.example: Self discipline matters more than talent in research careers, according to longitudinal studies of doctoral graduates.

english_explanations: the right or means to reach, enter or use something

chinese_translations.english: the right or ability to reach, enter or use a place, service or information
chinese_translations.example: Free public access to research findings accelerates scientific progress across developing countries considerably.

english_explanations: not extreme in degree, opinion or behaviour
average in amount or intensity

chinese_translations.english: kept within reasonable limits, not extreme in degree or opinion
chinese_translations.example: Moderate exercise several times a week lowers blood pressure without straining older hearts excessively.

english_explanations: very hot liquid rock found deep below the earth's surface

chinese_translations.english: extremely hot molten rock beneath the earth's crust, which becomes lava when released
chinese_translations.example: Rising magma beneath the caldera triggered small earthquakes weeks before the actual volcanic eruption occurred.

english_explanations: a chemical compound containing two oxygen atoms and one other element

chinese_translations.english: a chemical compound made of one element combined with two oxygen atoms
chinese_translations.example: Monitoring stations measure carbon dioxide concentrations continuously to verify national emissions reporting targets.

english_explanations: the greatest possible degree of something

chinese_translations.english: the greatest degree of a quality, or a condition far from normal or balanced
chinese_translations.example: Discipline works best at neither extreme: total permissiveness and harsh punishment both harm long term motivation.

english_explanations: to destroy the value or quality of something

chinese_translations.meaning: 损坏；破坏；宠坏；（食物）变质
chinese_translations.english: to damage or reduce the quality of something, or to make food unfit to eat
chinese_translations.example: Untreated sewage discharged during storms can spoil coastal waters long after the initial pollution event.

english_explanations: easily broken or damaged

chinese_translations.english: easily broken or damaged, or physically weak
chinese_translations.example: Coral reefs are fragile ecosystems that bleach rapidly when ocean temperatures rise even slightly above normal.
